drhp.business: The company provides Information Technology / Software Services and Software License Sale in India, and has extended into E-Vehicle Mobility following its acquisition of a stake in ETO Motors Private Limited. It also operates the Roqit digital mobility platform, focused on technology-enabled fleet and mobility management, through a wholly owned subsidiary.
drhp.expansion: The company transferred its SaaS platform development-in-progress (Roqit) to its wholly owned subsidiary Roqit Greenfleet Digital Solutions Private Limited on 2 July 2025, as part of business structuring, against allotment of shares. It also invested in Roqit Greenfleet Digital Solutions Private Limited and acquired an equity stake in ETO Motors Private Limited (now a subsidiary), adding E-Vehicle Mobility as a business line. No named capex quantum or dated capacity-expansion project is disclosed.
